title: That "package on hold" text is a trap #shorts
description:
Scam texts say your parcel is stuck and ask you to tap a link to pay a tiny fee or confirm your address. Never tap it: open the courier's official app or type its website yourself and enter your tracking number.

#cybersecurity #scam #smishing #onlinesafety #shorts
sub: This text is how they get your card...

points.d: the link asks for a small payment.
the fake page keeps your card details.

fix:
Never tap the link.
Open the courier's app yourself
fix_sub: Type your tracking number there instead.
question: Ever received this text? Yes or No in the comments
